intro.text: Roseland School of Dance Stony Brook sits right in the Stony Brook Village Center. Owner Ms. Michele Schmitt has been with Roseland for many years, and her two daughters grew up dancing here and now teach. Classes start at 12 months and grow with your dancer through kindergarten, tweens, teens and adults, from beginner to advanced. Each year students perform in a professionally produced recital.

faq: How young can my child start?
Classes start at 12 months, with toddler and preschool classes before kindergarten.
Yes. Each year students perform in Roseland's professionally produced recital for family and friends.
Does Roseland do anything in the community?
Yes. They help Girl Scout troops earn a dance badge, visit preschools and daycares with free Music and Movement classes, and dance at Stony Brook Village events.
